transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Thank you. Well, I think what finally scared me into making this appointment is that... I’ve been having these thoughts lately. Just things like, 'If I didn’t wake up tomorrow, that might be easier.' I really don’t want to hurt myself, I want to be clear about that. But just having those kinds of thoughts pop up... it worried me enough to come in.
I'm glad you reached out for help. Aside from these thoughts, how has your mood been lately?

Well, it's been pretty low, honestly. Most mornings lately, I wake up with this... heavy, gray feeling. It's almost like all the color has just drained out of everything before I even get dressed to head into the store for my shift. It just feels very flat and weighed down.
How long have you been feeling this low, heavy mood?

I'd say it's been about six months now for this low, flat feeling. It's been going on long enough that my usual routines... things like my art classes or taking my morning walks... they just stopped feeling restorative a while ago.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down or depressed before in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days or maybe a tough week here and there, like anyone else. But nothing like this... this heavy feeling that just doesn't go away. This is the first time it's lasted this long and felt this deep.
Have you ever experienced the opposite kind of feeling—a period where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world?

Well, yes, actually. Right before this slump hit, I did have a stretch where I felt... I guess almost too sure of myself. But I wouldn't just say I felt good or energetic. I was getting really easily frustrated, too. I would snap at people over tiny comments. Like, especially at work—if my district manager questioned my floor layouts, I would just snap right back at him. It was a very different kind of feeling.
About how long did that period of feeling unusually confident and easily frustrated last?

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. It's... it's a little hard to pin down exactly how long it went on. I didn't really track it at the time, you know? I just remember it was happening for a bit right before I crashed into this current slump.
During that time when you were feeling so confident and irritable, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual to feel rested?

No, not really. I mean... I still needed my regular sleep to get through my shifts at the store. I don't remember waking up early or feeling rested on just a few hours of sleep, if that's what you mean. My sleep schedule was pretty much the exact same as it usually is.
During that period, did you feel like your thoughts were racing or moving much faster than usual?
No, I didn't notice anything like that. My thoughts seemed pretty normal... just focused on getting things done at the store. I didn't feel like they were going too fast or anything.
During that period, did you find yourself doing anything impulsive or risky that was unusual for you, like spending excessive money or making rash decisions?

No, I didn't do anything like that. I'm usually pretty careful with my money, and that didn't change. I didn't make any big, rash decisions or do anything reckless. I was just... working and going about my normal routine, just feeling a bit more capable and easily annoyed than usual.
